newsitem.title: USA: Second explosion rocks Atlanta clinic - television.
newsitem.headline: Second explosion rocks Atlanta clinic - television.

text.p: A second explosion rocked a building housing an Atlanta abortion clinic on Thursday while federal officials combed through the debris left by a first blast, local television reported.
Live television coverage of the scene showed smoke pouring from a garbage container in the corner of the parking lot of the Atlanta Northside Family Planning centre after a loud bang.

Television reports said the second blast injured some people at the scene, including firefighters and a cameraman. An official described by television commentators as an agent of the U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms was shown being helped from the area.

The second blast occurred at about 10:38 a.m. EST (1538 GMT), a little over an hour after the first explosion shattered one side of the building and briefly engulfed the structure in flames and smoke.
Police said they suspected a bomb might have caused the initial explosion, in which there were no reports of injuries.
"It appears to have been some sort of device. It was not a natural explosion," Fulton County Police Lt. C.C. Cass said. Police said they received no warning calls before the blasts.
